decisive_items: frequent premature ventricular contractions triggering polymorphic ventricular tachycardia
High precordial ECG did not demonstrate Brugada pattern
response.rationale: PVC-triggered polymorphic VT is the hallmark of CPVT; QTc is normal, excluding LQTS, and Brugada pattern is absent. Genetic testing negative does not rule out CPVT given clinical presentation.

rejected.why: High precordial ECG did not demonstrate Brugada pattern, directly contradicting Brugada syndrome.
QTc intervals are within normal range (443 ms and 433 ms), lacking the prolonged QT required for LQTS.
